page.overview:
Who is Candy Person 231?

Jawbreaker Dude is a character who appears in "The Diary." He is pessimistic that he will survive his operation while Nurse Pound Cake slaps him and reassures him he'll survive. It is unknown if he died or not.

Jawbreaker Dude is a mostly purple Humanoid with with a partially licked head.
